listing.name: Isekai Portraits
listing.summary: Adds 456 anime-style portraits based on characters from various media.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 456 anime-style portraits based on characters from various media.

description:
A portrait pack adding 456 images in an Anime style based on characters from across various Anime, Manga, Video Games and "hand holding" works with some outfit variations

https://mega.nz/file/1IxkUIQQ#ei_Mt2ecJDRMJ25ImVIO1Dg5fNGG2VeBzfFAIR39qbg

All portraits have been added to the various factions equally, no vanilla portraits have been replaced or removed, I understand this could be immersion breaking however it's not my place to override any vanilla art from the game and I'm aware some mods do edit said vanilla portraits thus if this was a replacer pack it might conflict

All images were created through the use of

Stable Diffusion Automatic1111 Local

by loading an

Illustrious (IL)

based checkpoint model

Installation - Unzip and move the Isekai Portraits folder into your Starsector mods then tick the mod to activate it in the launcher

Uninstallation - Remove the Isekai Portraits folder from your Starsector mods

Content Warning
AI generated images

There is NO nudity as defined as nipples or genitalia visible

Some characters are depicted wearing revealing outfits including bikini tops, fantasy style clothing or have prominent busts

Some characters originate from Anime, Visual Novels and Manga which themselves are 18+ but depictions of such characters abide by the first point

Preview
Having to use Mega image links due to Imgur UK ban
https://mega.nz/file/JBhRnBaZ#Yt7bEPkBqE02enW2DwuaSD0ek1rr0pv3GHQIjkJtYlc
https://mega.nz/file/UYwHGJBb#cuQEpFOmyCTV4QKnTyLE4OAym89byHYZSRnOUSziYdw
https://mega.nz/file/oQQhBBpD#asxYo8yo6tQ-HyR2DIw55vrAZM0iLCybinSWiWgrTwY

Changelog
(05/02/2026) 1.0 - Initial 456 portraits

AI Usage Policy
This mod was created with AI image generation software, my position on AI image generation is that the creation of AI images does not make you an artist and that AI images should not be distributed for profit. AI image technology allows those who lack any artistic skill or ability to create images they want or need and such a tool should not be demonised or undermined. If you do not like AI images then simply move along and ignore them, to engage in threats, harassment and attempts to remove such content is nothing short of bullying and you would not tolerate it if such behaviour was directed towards your art by people or another artist demanding its removal for political or ideological reasons. The world is already a terrible place without more people willingly choosing to contribute to making it worse over some pixels

Suggestions/Requests
If you want a character added then feel free to suggest them ideally with their Name & Series and I'll see if I can add them
